title: Key Institutional Considerations for Designing Effective Independent Verification Organizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.10168v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Independent verification organizations (IVOs) have emerged as a popular, bipartisan solution for facilitating high-quality independent evaluations of AI technologies. But momentum is outpacing design: there is emerging consensus on the necessary operating conditions for robust IVOs, but little discourse on institutional and policy specifications to ensure those conditions are met. translated_title: 设计有效独立验证机构的关键制度考量
translated_abstract: 独立验证机构（IVOs）已成为促进对AI技术进行高质量独立评估的一种流行的、获得两党支持的解决方案。但发展势头已超越设计进度：关于健全IVOs所需必要运行条件的共识正在形成，然而对于确保满足这些条件的制度与政策规范却鲜有讨论。目前IVOs主要被设想为在AI前沿和模型层面运作的机制，用于评估灾难性风险。关于如何建立或监管一个能够应对各种风险（即超越灾难性风险的范围）、并能在AI生命周期的部署与使用阶段于系统层面和应用层面运作的IVO生态系统，相关工作仍然很少。本文认为，IVO的设计应确保具备在具体情境中为前沿企业和企业级公司评估AI模型、系统和应用的能力。
tldr: 本文提出设计有效独立验证机构（IVO）所需的关键制度考量，主张IVO生态系统应超越灾难性风险评估，扩展至AI生命周期的系统与应用层面，为前沿企业和企业级公司提供情境化的AI模型、系统及应用评估。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies key institutional considerations for designing effective Independent Verification Organizations (IVOs), arguing that the IVO ecosystem should go beyond catastrophic risk evaluation to enable contextual assessment of AI models, systems, and applications at the system and application level across the AI lifecycle for both frontier and enterprise companies.
